title: AutoFigure Case 11 · DeepScientist
sourceProvenance: User-provided AutoFigure-Edit case/11.png; left original diagram cropped without scaling, segmentation or generative editing. Only the PNG and these written requirements are submitted.
comparisonSubtitle: 上方主流程 · 下方三个细节分区 · 人物与工具矢量简化；输入只有原图 PNG 和文字要求
method: Reconstruct the attached DeepScientist research architecture as an editable SVG, faithfully following this original image. The input contains one original diagram only, not the editor's blue selection boxes. Set width=3760, height=2220, viewBox='0 0 3760 2220' so the source aspect ratio is unchanged. Preserve the dashed outer boundary, the three phase headings (Strategize & Hypothesize, Implement & Verify, Analyze & Report), the upper overview and the three lower detail panels. Required editable labels are: Phases; DeepScientist; Findings Memory; Idea Findings; Implement Findings; Progress Findings; Surrogate Model; Acquisition Function (UCB); Score; Top Candidate; Coding Agent; Sandboxed Environment; Code Implementation; Experimentation; Experiment Logs & Results; Human; REPLACE; EDIT; old code; new code; line edits; old report; i candidate; code repair (x3); code succeeds; Self-Reflection; reward function; Program Scoring; Analysis Agent; Experiment Charts; Ablations & Evaluations; Synthesis Agent; MCP Tools; Research Paper; PDF. Preserve repeated actors/memory labels in both overview and lower detail, rather than deleting duplicates. Overview relations: DeepScientist exchanges information with Findings Memory using two opposite arrows; Findings Memory feeds Surrogate Model, which feeds Acquisition Function (UCB); acquisition selects the Top Candidate for the Coding Agent and points down to the Top Candidate callout. Coding Agent points to the sandbox, where Code Implementation and Experimentation form the visible iteration; sandbox execution produces Experiment Logs & Results. The pale connectors to the lower panels are zoom/callout guides, not additional dataflow edges. Lower-left: Human feeds DeepScientist, then Findings Memory, then the lower Coding Agent. Lower-middle: preserve the separate REPLACE and EDIT branches with their code/report documents, convergence at new code, i candidate, the pink code-repair loop with x3, the green code-succeeds path to Program Scoring and reward function, and the feedback through Self-Reflection to the Coding Agent. Lower-right: Experimentation feeds Analysis Agent; preserve Analysis Agent's branches to Experiment Charts and Synthesis Agent, Ablations & Evaluations to Synthesis Agent, Synthesis Agent and Experiment Logs & Results to MCP Tools, and MCP Tools to Research Paper. Use the original image as the final authority on arrow endpoints and directions. Place named components in separate g groups containing the icon and its label, with identifiable ids, so a component can move as a unit; keep connectors independent of component groups. All labels must be text/tspan. Simplify the pixel-art people, brain/chip, bulb, documents, globe, charts, PDF/Python/tool/trophy icons into small colored vector pictograms retaining their recognizable roles, clothing colors, and approximate positions. Reuse vector icons in defs/use where appropriate. Do not replace the entire figure with an embedded image, do not fetch external icons, and do not create any unprovided data or relationships.
style: Faithful academic architecture diagram: white canvas, light-gray phase bars and panels, thin gray boundaries and pale callout connectors, black directed arrows, colored compact pictograms. Preserve the original arrangement and proportions. Render English labels using a readable installed sans-serif such as Arial; group multiline labels with their module. Decorative icons may be simplified, but do not omit their role or convert editable labels to outlines.
checks: Overview and three detailed regions remain distinct
Arrow endpoints, directions and feedback loops match the reference
Pixel-art pictograms remain recognizable after vector simplification
SVG-Edit text editing, undo/redo and save/reopen work
Independent visual review requires the actual reference and native export PNG
scope: User-selected public development sample, with preregistered text requirements; not an image-only blind test, a P3 holdout, or a matched upstream quality/cost comparison
